description: EF 3.1 has no lake compartment, and GreenDelta's openLCA package ships two rows each of `Cadmium II`, `Nickel II` and `Arsenic ion` to Emission to water/lake: in each pair one row copies EF's surface-water number and the other its unspecified-water number, whatever registry number it carries. Both reach one flow of ours, so on the six-list build of 3b6528e GreenDelta's implementation published neither, 11 times. A lake is surface water in this list's vocabulary, and rulings in lcia-factor-collision-rulings.json publish the surface-water row (#446, using #444).

expectations.title: GreenDelta's Human toxicity, cancer factor for Arsenic, ion in lake water is 3.4101e-05, EF's surface-water number
expectations.comment: The package's rows 0cc4fa9c and c0f8b131 state 3.4101e-05 and 1.8565e-05, EF's surface-water and unspecified-water numbers. On the build of 3b6528e GreenDelta's implementation published neither; the ruling publishes the surface-water row's, which is also what the consensus carries into lake water.
